tolerance.metric: absolute difference in historical family margin or one-sided LCB95 versus committed frozen reference

permitted_use: cross-environment floating-point equivalence for family margins and LCB95
forbidden_use: retuning any estimator or nuisance family
acceptance_rule: Every historical gating-family margin and LCB95, held-out diagnostic margin/LCB95, and OUTSPAN_TECH margin/LCB95 must agree with the committed reference within 1e-12 absolute AND every PASS/FAIL/generalisation label must be identical. Otherwise STOP.
calibrated_mode_requirement: A calibrated realism qualification may not run unless it consumes a historical-reproduction receipt satisfying this rule and binding the same tournament, estimator, stress-runner and source digests.
